data.circuit_description:
电路概况: 共 11 个元件 (IC×1, Resistor×6, Wire×4), 12 个电气网络

元件连接:
  W1 (Wire): pin1=LN20(Net_4), pin2=D19(Net_4)
  W2 (Wire): pin1=C21(Net_1), pin2=G25(Net_1)
  W3 (Wire): pin1=J23(Net_11), pin2=RP26(Net_11)
  W4 (Wire): pin1=B15(Net_9), pin2=A20(Net_9)
  R1 (Resistor): pin1=C15(Net_9), pin2=F15(Net_2)
  R2 (Resistor): pin1=I15(Net_2), pin2=RP11(Net_11)
  R3 (Resistor): pin1=I16(Net_6), pin2=I20(Net_10)
  R4 (Resistor): pin1=I21(Net_3), pin2=RP16(Net_11)
  R5 (Resistor): pin1=H20(Net_10), pin2=H24(Net_8)
  R6 (Resistor): pin1=G15(Net_2), pin2=G19(Net_7)
  IC1 (IC): pin1=F19(Net_7), pin2=F20(Net_10), pin3=F21(Net_3), pin4=F22(Net_12), pin5=E22(Net_5), pin6=E21(Net_1), pin7=E20(Net_9), pin8=E19(Net_4)

电气网络:
  Net_1: ROW_21_L, ROW_25_R → 元件: IC1, W2
  Net_2: ROW_15_R → 元件: R1, R2, R6
  Net_3: ROW_21_R → 元件: IC1, R4
  Net_4 [VCC]: ROW_19_L, TRACK_LN_SEG1 → 元件: IC1, W1
  Net_5: ROW_22_L → 元件: IC1
  Net_6: ROW_16_R → 元件: R3
  Net_7: ROW_19_R → 元件: IC1, R6
  Net_8: ROW_24_R → 元件: R5
  Net_9: ROW_15_L, ROW_20_L → 元件: IC1, R1, W4
  Net_10: ROW_20_R → 元件: IC1, R3, R5
  Net_11 [GND]: ROW_23_R, TRACK_RP_SEG1 → 元件: R2, R4, W3
  Net_12: ROW_22_R → 元件: IC1

电源:
  TRACK_LN_SEG1 → VCC
  TRACK_RP_SEG1 → GND
